summary: SK hynix filed a Form 6-K disclosing a routine board decision to dispose of 82 treasury common shares at KRW 1,495,000 per share, an aggregate value of KRW 122,590,000, to compensate independent directors. The disposal runs from August 8 to September 7, 2026, with delivery on or after August 19, 2026. Shares transfer directly from the company's treasury account to recipients' accounts via SK Securities. This is immaterial compensation, not a capital return or special situation; the filing merely meets Korean disclosure obligations. No strategic implications, premium, or risk-arb angle exists. Watch for no further disclosures.
